whats_new:
Crews have much more to build together: ten Crew Mega Builds, from a castle to a volcano island. Everyone in the crew builds the same big picture tile by tile, for as long as they like, and the next builder carries on.
• Pass the Puzzle: whoever starts it picks how many steps each turn, and anyone in the crew can see the puzzle so far
• Leave a crew from its own page, and Share now sends a link that opens your crew
• Bibi's Weekly Bloppit starts straight away, with no countdown
• On the first trip, tell Bloppit who's building: your name and age (they stay on this device)
• iPhone Duo: open it and the booklet sits beside the build
• Smaller fixes
